Two Japanese hands pick it at the same time: on the left a woman's hand in a MAROON jacket sleeve, on the right a man's hand in a grey jacket sleeve, a woven basket with a few bundles already inside between them. Only hands and forearms are visible, no face visible. Bare trees behind, No snow anywhere, no frost, no ice, no winter.
